description: GamePulse metrics ingest pipeline — normalizes fields, classifies hardware tiers, and tags anomalies

script.description: Classify hardware tier based on GPU model and VRAM
script.source: if (ctx.gpu == null) return; def vram = ctx.gpu.memory_total_mb; if (vram == null) return; if (vram >= 16384) { ctx.hardware_tier = 'enthusiast'; } else if (vram >= 8192) { ctx.hardware_tier = 'high'; } else if (vram >= 4096) { ctx.hardware_tier = 'mid'; } else if (vram >= 2048) { ctx.hardware_tier = 'low'; } else { ctx.hardware_tier = 'integrated'; }

script.description: Classify FPS bracket for easy filtering
script.source: if (ctx.fps == null || ctx.fps.fps_avg == null) return; def avg = ctx.fps.fps_avg; if (avg >= 120) { ctx.fps_bracket = '120+'; } else if (avg >= 90) { ctx.fps_bracket = '90-120'; } else if (avg >= 60) { ctx.fps_bracket = '60-90'; } else if (avg >= 30) { ctx.fps_bracket = '30-60'; } else { ctx.fps_bracket = 'below_30'; }

script.description: Tag thermal throttling if GPU temp > 90 or CPU temp > 95
script.source: ctx.throttle_detected = false; if (ctx.gpu != null && ctx.gpu.temperature_c != null && ctx.gpu.temperature_c > 90) { ctx.throttle_detected = true; ctx.throttle_source = 'gpu_thermal'; } if (ctx.cpu != null && ctx.cpu.temperature_c != null && ctx.cpu.temperature_c > 95) { ctx.throttle_detected = true; ctx.throttle_source = 'cpu_thermal'; }

if (ctx.fps == null) return; ctx.has_stutter = (ctx.fps.stutter_count != null && ctx.fps.stutter_count > 0); if (ctx.fps.frametime_max_ms != null && ctx.fps.frametime_max_ms > 100) { ctx.severe_stutter = true; }

if (ctx.gpu == null || ctx.gpu.memory_used_mb == null || ctx.gpu.memory_total_mb == null) return; if (ctx.gpu.memory_total_mb > 0) { ctx.gpu.memory_pressure_pct = (ctx.gpu.memory_used_mb * 100.0) / ctx.gpu.memory_total_mb; }

script.description: Tag storage bottleneck if I/O wait > 5% or queue depth > 32
script.source: if (ctx.storage == null) return; ctx.storage_bottleneck = false; if (ctx.storage.io_wait_pct != null && ctx.storage.io_wait_pct > 5.0) { ctx.storage_bottleneck = true; } if (ctx.storage.queue_depth != null && ctx.storage.queue_depth > 32) { ctx.storage_bottleneck = true; }
